PLAN "12-Week Plant-Based Muscle Gain"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary hypertrophy:
    name "Build lean muscle on vegan diet"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower Quad":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          lat_stretch 60s
